review_candidates.title: Staff Applications Engineer
review_candidates.description: Please Note: To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. At CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. We are looking to add several Staff Applications Engineer to our rapidly growing customer-facing team. In this position, you will represent Cesium as a technical expert on our products, building relationships with our customers from the marketing stage all the way through in-orbit support. A major part of CesiumAstro’s mission is to deliver space communication systems that work out of the box, and the Applications Engineering Team will play a crucial role in delivering that seamless user experience. As a CesiumAstro Applications Engineer, you can expect a varied and dynamic day-to-day workflow. Some days will be spent in the lab with CesiumAstro design engineers, learning the ins and outs of our hardware and software. Some days will be spent helping shape the Cesium product roadmap by providing feedback on customer needs, goals, and user experience; you will act as the “Voice of the Customer” to provide insight and clarity to developers. Some days will be spent at customers’ labs or on video calls, teaching customers how to use our products. Some days will be spent crafting app notes and diagrams to provide users with a space communication system that truly works out of the box. This role is heavily focused on technical customer interaction. As such, exceptional technical communication skills are required. Candidates with relevant work samples, such as public app notes or user manuals, will be highly preferred. This role may require up to 20% travel to customer facilities and trade shows. Job Duties And Responsibilities Guide technical customers through the use and integration of CesiumAstro products. Author technical application notes, user manuals, and white papers. Transfer customer feedback to our product development teams. Build long-term relationships with technical customers. Rapidly understand, troubleshoot, recreate, and solve customer-reported anomalies. Develop processes and procedures to structure product development and application. Become a technical expert in Cesium’s products in depth to execute the above. This includes state-of-the-art RF, digital, and power electronics; embedded software; FPGAs; DSP; mechanical integration; and end-to-end wireless communication links. Provide technical leadership and direction to the Business Development Team Job Requirements And Minimum Qualifications At least 8 years of relevant experience in technical product development or application support. Working knowledge of RF electronics and communication systems. Experience with FPGA and embedded software for applications with software-defined radios. Exceptional technical communication skills. Experience building relationships with technical customers. Experience with the methodical troubleshooting of electronics and software. Working software proficiency in C/C++ or Python. In-depth experience with RF electronics and communication systems, including link budgets. Experience with a broad range of technical areas, such as high-speed digital systems (10+ Gbps), power electronics, FPGAs, DSP, embedded software, and mechanical interfaces (i.e. thermal, dynamics). Preferred Experience Work samples of technical communication, such as public app notes or user manuals. Experience with high-reliability electronics, such as aerospace. Experience with small satellites. Experience in technical product planning, marketing, or sales. Experience with crafting technical solutions that meet customer needs on proposals. $158,000 - $189,000 a year CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Full-time employment offers include company stock options and a generous benefits package including health, dental, vision, HSA, FSA, life, disability and retirement plans. CesiumAstro is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

review_candidates.description: Hertfordshire Constabulary Police Staff Permanent Full Time ICT Headquarters, Huntingdon, Cambs , Headquarters, WGC, Herts A4 £32,613 37 A great opportunity has arisen to join a growing support team as an ICT Senior Service Desk Analyst within the BCH (Beds, Cambs & Herts) ICT Department. Join the exciting and dynamic world of policing and contribute towards making Bedfordshire, Cambridgeshire and Hertfordshire a safer place. Based at Hertfordshire Constabulary HQ or Cambridgeshire Constabulary, you will play a key role within the ICT Operations Team, supporting the tri-force ICT estate and ensuring that vital business systems remain highly available to officers and staff. About The Role As a Senior Service Desk Analyst, you will provide first-line ICT support while also taking on additional responsibility for supporting and guiding a team of five analysts. You will act as an escalation point for more complex or non-standard issues, helping to drive service quality and improve first-time fix rates. You will use your technical knowledge and customer service skills to diagnose hardware, software and communication issues reported via phone or self-service. Where resolution is not possible at first contact, you will ensure incidents are accurately logged, fully documented, and escalated within agreed SLAs, maintaining clear communication with users throughout. You will also contribute to continuous improvement by maintaining knowledge base articles and coaching the development of colleagues across the Service Desk. Why Join BCH ICT? Bedfordshire, Cambridgeshire and Hertfordshire Police form one of the largest and most established collaborations in the UK. This role offers a fantastic opportunity to develop your career within a supportive and forward-thinking ICT environment, with exposure to a diverse technology estate and opportunities to build leadership experience. Employee Benefits 25 days annual leave, rising to 29 after 5 years’ service (plus public holidays) Competitive Local Government Pension Scheme Access to on-site gym facilities at HQ locations Hybrid working arrangements Blue Light Card discounts Sports and social club membership Employee Assistance Programme Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Everyone at Bedfordshire, Cambridgeshire and Hertfordshire takes personal responsibility to help create an inclusive workplace, where police officers and staff respect one another, feel valued for their differences and can be themselves. We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments, wherever needed so everyone feels welcome and can flourish. We are working hard to continue to enhance and increase our diversity across the three forces, where communities are under-represented, including those from Black, Asian and Minority Ethnic communities, people of all ages, abilities, faiths, religions and gender, LGBT communities and those from other disadvantaged or marginalised backgrounds, who share our values and wish to make a difference to the communities we serve. All applications will be treated on merit, based on the evidence provided in your application and your suitability for the role for which you have applied. We are a Disability Confident employer offering a guaranteed interview scheme for all candidates with a disability covered by the Equality Act 2010 who meet the minimum entry requirements. Should you require any reasonable adjustments for your application process, please contact the HR Recruitment Centre on 01438 757 777. Flexible Working BCH supports agile and flexible working wherever possible. All requests will be considered in line with operational requirements. Police Barred and Advisory lists Individuals placed on the Police Barred and Advisory lists will not be considered for employment by the police for a minimum of 5 years from the date of listing in the case of gross misconduct, or 3 years from the date of listing in the case of poor performance. Vetting and Safeguarding BCH are committed to safeguarding and operate safer recruitment processes, to ensure a police service that employees are proud to work for because they feel safe, valued and part of a happy and supportive work environment. All employees and volunteers therefore will be subject to background checks including vetting and references. Please be aware the Police Corporate Vetting Unit will undertake security vetting on successful candidates, their family and others that live at their home address, which will include financial checks. How To Apply If you are successful, you will be joining one of the most accomplished policing collaborations in the UK where our vision for the future of BCH Policing is exhibited daily across the full breadth of capabilities and functions we deliver. Please Submit Your CV Along With Evidence of your relevant skills and experience A 500-word statement demonstrating how you meet the minimum entry requirements For further information, please contact Jamie Read (BCH Operations, ICT Service Desk Team Leader) via Jamie.Read@cambs.police.uk Additional Advert Information Internal Applicants To apply for this role, internal applicants must have successfully completed their probationary period. If you qualify as an internal candidate within the advertising force, you may upload either your CV or the internal role summary form attached to this advert. Vetting Process Please note that, as part of the vetting process, the BCH Vetting Unit may need to contact your current line manager for a Supervisor Appraisal. This requirement aligns with the 2025 National Guidelines for Vetting (APP 6.5.18). Examples Of When This May Apply Include Transferring to another force Renewing vetting clearance Moving into a role requiring MV clearance (even if you currently hold MV clearance) Moving into or working in a role involving close contact with vulnerable individuals If any of the above apply to you, please expect your line manager to be contacted when you submit your vetting application. Redeployment and Redundancy This vacancy is open to employees at risk of redundancy and will remain available to redeployees until a final offer has been agreed and accepted. Redeployees at risk of redundancy will take priority over all other applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. If successful, redeployees will remain on their home force’s terms and conditions. Role Profile We recommend downloading and saving a copy of the role profile, as it will no longer be accessible once the advert closes. Commitment to Inclusion As a Disability Confident Leader, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and able to be themselves. We provide workplace adjustments wherever needed so that all colleagues can thrive. If you have a disability and meet the minimum criteria for the role, you will be guaranteed an interview under the Offer an Interview Scheme.

review_candidates.description: About The Company Delta System & Software, Inc. is a rapidly expanding IT staffing and professional services firm renowned for its expertise in SAP, Guidewire, Cloud, AI, ML, SRE, data, and application development. Headquartered in Texas, Delta boasts a global presence with offices across the USA, Canada, India, Europe, the Middle East, and Australia. The company specializes in delivering comprehensive business and technology consulting, digital transformation solutions, application development, and ongoing maintenance and support services. Committed to fostering innovation and excellence, Delta strives to help clients achieve their strategic objectives through tailored technology solutions. With a focus on quality, integrity, and customer satisfaction, Delta has established itself as a trusted partner in the IT industry. About The Role The MDM Data Engineer at Delta System & Software, Inc. will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and maintaining enterprise data pipelines and models that underpin the company's Master Data Management (MDM) initiatives. This remote, offshore position requires a seasoned professional with extensive experience in data engineering, data modeling, and MDM concepts. The engineer will work closely with onshore data architecture and platform teams to ingest data from multiple authoritative sources such as SAP, Salesforce/Engage, and others, ensuring seamless integration and high data quality. The role involves developing layered data architectures—covering RAW, STAGED, and PROFILE layers—and contributing to the development of graph-based MDM models that encompass entities like Clubs, Schools, Colleges, and Individuals, as well as product style and variant models. The position offers an excellent opportunity to work on complex data projects within a collaborative environment, leveraging advanced tools and techniques to deliver scalable, efficient, and accurate data solutions. Qualifications The ideal candidate will possess a minimum of 8+ years of IT experience with a strong background in data engineering and MDM. Essential qualifications include expertise in Snowflake (minimum 5 years), PL/SQL (5 years), Master Data Management (5 years), scripting with Python (5 years), and experience with SAP, Salesforce, or similar systems. Candidates should demonstrate proficiency in data profiling, data quality, and layered data architecture implementation. Strong knowledge of data modeling across relational, dimensional, and graph structures is required. Practical experience with DevOps practices, automation scripting, and Agile methodologies is highly desirable. A proven track record of working with large datasets, performance tuning, and implementing enterprise-grade data solutions is essential. Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across geographically dispersed teams are critical for success in this role. Responsibilities Design, develop, and operate scalable data pipelines and models on Snowflake, ensuring optimal performance, resource management, and cost efficiency. Implement layered data architectures (RAW/STAGED/PROFILE) for ingestion, standardization, deduplication, and publication of enterprise data. Extract, transform, and load data from SAP, Salesforce, and other sources, ensuring high data quality and integrity. Develop and maintain advanced SQL queries, including window functions, recursive CTEs, and complex joins for data analysis and troubleshooting. Create reusable Python scripts and libraries for data ingestion, transformation, and automation tasks. Perform data profiling and quality assessments, implementing validation rules and anomaly detection in a database-agnostic manner. Implement MDM concepts such as match/merge, survivorship rules, hierarchy management, and golden record creation. Develop and maintain data models, including relational, dimensional, and graph schemas, to support enterprise data needs. Apply DevOps practices by managing code repositories, conducting code reviews, and deploying updates through CI/CD pipelines. Automate manual data operations using scripting and orchestration tools like Airflow, Snowflake Tasks, or similar. Collaborate with onshore teams to understand requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deliver high-quality data solutions within an Agile environment. Participate in continuous learning to stay updated with emerging data technologies, tools, and best practices. Benefits Delta System & Software, Inc. offers competitive compensation packages, including comprehensive health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off. Employees benefit from flexible work arrangements, professional development opportunities, and a collaborative work environment that fosters innovation and growth. The company supports work-life balance and provides resources to help employees excel in their careers. Additionally, team members have access to cutting-edge tools and technologies, enabling them to work on challenging and impactful projects that contribute to their professional advancement. Equal Opportunity Delta System & Software, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, citizenship, national origin, ancestry, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. Our goal is to foster a workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to contribute to the company's success.
